name: Empty / Cleared
short_description: A cleared Avenger grid cell, ready for a facility to be built on it.

attributes.gameplay_effect: No facility built yet; any buildable facility can be constructed here.

name: Alien Debris
short_description: Wreckage left in the Avenger's hull from its crash/theft; must be cleared by engineers before a facility can be built.

attributes.gameplay_effect: Blocks the cell from facility construction until cleared; can appear in any of the Avenger's four rows.

name: Alien Machinery
short_description: Alien technology embedded in the Avenger's hull; requires more engineer-time to clear than Alien Debris.

attributes.clear_reward: Supplies and Alien Alloys when cleared.
attributes.gameplay_effect: Blocks the cell from facility construction until cleared; only appears in the bottom three rows of the Avenger grid.

name: Exposed Power Coil
short_description: A damaged power conduit; clearing it ('shielding') takes the longest of the three hazard states but grants a permanent power bonus to whatever is built there.

attributes.gameplay_effect: There are always exactly two Exposed Power Coil cells on the Avenger, both in the bottom two rows. A facility built on a cleared coil costs 0 power to operate; a Power Relay built on one provides substantially more power than normal.

name: Supplies
short_description: The primary resource for building facilities, upgrades and items.

name: Intel
short_description: Spent on the Black Market, covert actions and resistance orders.

name: Alien Alloys
short_description: A material resource used in armor and weapon construction.

name: Elerium Crystals
short_description: A rare material resource required for advanced weapon/armor research and construction.

name: Elerium Cores
short_description: A late-game material resource used for top-tier equipment.

name: ADVENT Trooper Corpse
short_description: Recovered from slain ADVENT Troopers; required for the ADVENT Trooper Autopsy.

name: ADVENT Officer Corpse
short_description: Recovered from slain ADVENT Officers; required for the ADVENT Officer Autopsy.

name: Sectoid Corpse
short_description: Recovered from slain Sectoids; required for the Sectoid Autopsy.

name: Viper Corpse
short_description: Recovered from slain Vipers; required for the Viper Autopsy.

name: Muton Corpse
short_description: Recovered from slain Mutons; required for the Muton Autopsy.

name: Proving Ground
short_description: Allows construction of experimental equipment (ammo, grenades, armor) via Proving Ground projects.

attributes.staffing_slots: 1 Engineer -- increases project completion rate by 50%.

name: Guerrilla Tactics School
short_description: Trains rookies into soldier classes; sells squad-wide upgrades (e.g. extra squad size).

name: Laboratory
short_description: Increases research speed; boosts breakthrough chance.

attributes.staffing_slots: Up to 2 Scientists -- each staffed scientist doubles research output.

name: Workshop
short_description: Produces Gremlins that can staff adjacent facilities as engineers.

name: Power Relay
short_description: Generates additional power for other facilities.

attributes.staffing_slots: 1-2 Engineers -- each staffed engineer provides +5 power.

name: Resistance Comms
short_description: Increases resistance-contact capacity; each staffed engineer adds more contacts.

name: Defense Matrix
short_description: Deploys XCOM turrets for Avenger-defense missions.

attributes.staffing_slots: 1 Engineer -- improves turret aim and damage.
attributes.ruleset_note: Build time not stated in cited source.

name: Psi Lab
short_description: Trains rookies as Psi Operatives.

name: Shadow Chamber
short_description: Performs special story-related research projects; reveals mission alien composition on the Geoscape.

attributes.ruleset_note: Build time not stated in cited source.

name: Advanced Warfare Center
short_description: Heals injured soldiers faster and grants a random cross-class bonus ability per soldier. Vanilla XCOM 2 only -- see ruleset_note.

attributes.staffing_slots: 1 Engineer -- increases healing rate to 100% (from 50% base).
attributes.ruleset_note: Does NOT exist as a buildable facility in War of the Chosen -- its healing function is replaced by the Infirmary and its ability-retraining function by the Training Center (see the `wotc` content source). This object remains importable for vanilla-ruleset campaigns only.

name: Alien Biotech
short_description: Foundational xenobiology research; unlocks autopsy projects.

name: Hybrid Materials
short_description: Foundational materials research; a prerequisite for Magnetic Weapons and combat-armor research.

name: ADVENT Trooper Autopsy
short_description: Unlocks the Battle Scanner.

name: ADVENT Officer Autopsy
short_description: Unlocks the Proving Ground facility.

name: Sectoid Autopsy
short_description: Unlocks Mindshield and Psionics research.

name: Viper Autopsy
short_description: Unlocks the Battlefield Medicine Proving Ground project.

name: Muton Autopsy
short_description: Unlocks Plasma Grenades and the Advanced Explosives Proving Ground project.

name: Modular Weapons
short_description: Unlocks weapon upgrade slots.

name: Magnetic Weapons
short_description: Unlocks Mag Pistol, Mag Rifle and Shard Gun.

name: Gauss Weapons
short_description: Unlocks Gauss Rifle and Mag Cannon; unlocks Elerium research.

name: Elerium
short_description: Unlocks Powered Armor and Plasma Rifle research.

name: Plasma Rifle
short_description: Unlocks the Plasma Rifle and Beam Pistol, and further Beam weapon research.

name: Plated Armor
short_description: Unlocks Predator Armor.

name: Powered Armor
short_description: Unlocks Warden Armor.

name: Psionics
short_description: Unlocks the Psi Lab facility and the Advanced Psi Amp.

name: Resistance Communications
short_description: Unlocks the Resistance Comms facility. Completed after the first Guerrilla Op.

name: Assault Rifle
short_description: Conventional-tier assault rifle; the Specialist's default primary weapon.

name: Mag Rifle
short_description: Magnetic-tier assault rifle.

name: Plasma Rifle
short_description: Plasma-tier assault rifle.

name: Shotgun
short_description: Conventional-tier shotgun; the Ranger's default primary weapon.

name: Shard Gun
short_description: Magnetic-tier shotgun.

name: Storm Gun
short_description: Plasma-tier shotgun.

name: Sniper Rifle
short_description: Conventional-tier sniper rifle; the Sharpshooter's default primary weapon.

name: Gauss Rifle
short_description: Magnetic-tier sniper rifle.

name: Plasma Lance
short_description: Plasma-tier sniper rifle.

name: Cannon
short_description: Conventional-tier LMG; the Grenadier's default primary weapon.

name: Mag Cannon
short_description: Magnetic-tier LMG.

name: Beam Cannon
short_description: Plasma-tier LMG.

name: Pistol
short_description: Conventional-tier sidearm; the Sharpshooter's secondary weapon. Cannot receive weapon upgrades.

name: Mag Pistol
short_description: Magnetic-tier sidearm.

name: Beam Pistol
short_description: Plasma-tier sidearm.

name: Scope
short_description: Weapon upgrade: adds an aim bonus.

attributes.effect_summary: Adds an aim bonus; Advanced and Superior variants add progressively more.

name: Laser Sight
short_description: Weapon upgrade: adds a critical-hit chance bonus.

attributes.effect_summary: Adds a critical-hit chance bonus; Advanced and Superior variants add progressively more.

name: Repeater
short_description: Weapon upgrade: a small chance to instantly kill a non-boss target on hit.

attributes.effect_summary: Small chance to instantly kill on hit; Advanced and Superior variants increase the chance.

name: Hair Trigger
short_description: Weapon upgrade: a chance for a shot to be a free action.

attributes.effect_summary: Chance of a free extra shot; Advanced and Superior variants increase the chance.

name: Auto-Loader
short_description: Weapon upgrade: provides a free reload.

attributes.effect_summary: Grants free reload charges; Advanced and Superior variants grant more.

name: Extended Magazine
short_description: Weapon upgrade: increases ammo capacity.

attributes.effect_summary: Adds ammo capacity; Advanced and Superior variants add more.

name: Stock
short_description: Weapon upgrade: guarantees some damage on a missed shot, reduced by target armor.

attributes.effect_summary: Guarantees minimum damage on a miss; Advanced and Superior variants guarantee more.

name: Kevlar Armor
short_description: Starting armor; no research prerequisite.

name: Predator Armor
short_description: Mid-tier armor; grants an additional utility slot.

name: Warden Armor
short_description: Powered-armor tier; grants an additional utility slot and an armor bonus.

name: Ranger
short_description: Close-quarters specialist; shotgun and sword.

attributes.primary_weapon_categories: Shotgun (also Assault Rifle at higher tech tiers via some ability trees)

name: Sharpshooter
short_description: Long-range specialist; sniper rifle and pistol.

name: Grenadier
short_description: Area-damage and armor-shredding specialist; cannon and grenade launcher.

name: Specialist
short_description: Support/hacking specialist; assault rifle and Gremlin drone.

name: Psi Operative
short_description: Psionic specialist; trained at the Psi Lab rather than the GTS, with abilities unlocked through psionic training rather than rank-up choices.

name: Rookie
short_description: The unclassed baseline a newly recruited soldier starts as, before being trained into a class at the Guerrilla Tactics School (or the Psi Lab, for Psi Operatives). Used to attach ruleset/difficulty-aware default stats (see catalog_soldier_stat_profiles) that a soldier-creation flow initializes from.

name: Battle Scanner
short_description: Proving Ground project unlocked by the ADVENT Trooper Autopsy; produces the Battle Scanner utility item.

name: Battlefield Medicine
short_description: Proving Ground project unlocked by the Viper Autopsy; produces the Nanomedikit.

name: Advanced Explosives
short_description: Proving Ground project unlocked by the Muton Autopsy; produces upgraded (Mk2) grenade variants.

name: Skulljack
short_description: Proving Ground project requiring an ADVENT Officer corpse; produces the Skulljack utility item used to hack the Codex's brain.

name: Battle Scanner
short_description: Deployable scanner that reveals nearby enemy signatures, including Faceless and burrowed Chryssalids.

attributes.effect_summary: Reveals enemy signatures in an area around the deployed scanner.

name: Nanomedikit
short_description: Upgraded Medikit, produced by the Battlefield Medicine Proving Ground project.

attributes.effect_summary: Heals more HP per charge than the basic Medikit.

name: Medikit
short_description: Basic healing item; available from the start of the campaign.

attributes.effect_summary: Heals HP; Specialists can deploy it remotely via the Gremlin's Medic Protocol ability.

name: Mindshield
short_description: Unlocked by the Sectoid Autopsy; protects the wearer against negative mental effects (panic, mind control).

attributes.effect_summary: Immunity to panic and mind control.

name: Skulljack
short_description: Produced by the Skulljack Proving Ground project; used in melee to hack an enemy's neural implant.

attributes.effect_summary: Melee neural-hack attack, required for the Codex Brain story research.

name: Frag Grenade
short_description: Basic explosive grenade; available from the start of the campaign.

name: Flashbang Grenade
short_description: Disorients enemies in the blast radius; available from the start of the campaign.

name: Smoke Grenade
short_description: Grants defensive bonuses to units in the smoke cloud; available from the start of the campaign.

name: Plasma Grenade
short_description: Advanced-tier grenade unlocked via the Muton Autopsy and Advanced Explosives.

name: AP Rounds
short_description: Weapon ammo upgrade unlocked by Alien Biotech; grants armor-piercing damage.

name: Tracer Rounds
short_description: Weapon ammo upgrade unlocked by Hybrid Materials; improves aim.

name: ADVENT Trooper
short_description: Standard ADVENT infantry unit; its corpse is required for the ADVENT Trooper Autopsy.

name: ADVENT Officer
short_description: ADVENT command unit; its corpse is required for the ADVENT Officer Autopsy, which unlocks the Proving Ground.

name: Sectoid
short_description: Early-game alien psionic unit; its corpse is required for the Sectoid Autopsy, which unlocks Psionics research.

name: Viper
short_description: Alien unit with a tongue-pull grab attack; its corpse is required for the Viper Autopsy, which unlocks Battlefield Medicine.

name: Muton
short_description: Heavy alien infantry unit; its corpse is required for the Muton Autopsy, which unlocks Plasma Grenades and Advanced Explosives.
